message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried pasta sheets (or no-boil sheets) |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef or Italian sausage, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, tomato paste, olive oil, salt, pepper, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes (optional) |
| **Bechamel (white sauce)** | Butter, all‑purpose flour, milk, nutmeg, salt, pepper |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese, egg, grated Parmesan, chopped parsley or basil, salt, pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | Grated Parmesan for topping |
| **Optional extras** | Sautéed spinach, mushrooms, zucchini, or bell peppers; a splash of white wine in the meat sauce; fresh herbs for garnish |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on how many servings you want and your taste preferences!
